hypothesis: Coarse hardness classification supplies an additional supervised gradient to the same64-dimensional hidden representation; this can regularize or interfere with regression. Classifier is not independent of regression sharedMLP.
source_access: Official writeup opened but no body exposed by browser. Indexed primary-source snippet confirms SmoothL1 regression plus CrossEntropy classification; seven bins/0.3 and published scores supplied by parent, not independently fully re-read here. No external code, data or weights downloaded.
transfer_limits: Own small frozenDINOv2 head, one hardness target, foldtrain quantile bins. Not a reproduction of DINOv3Large five-target trainable-backbone solution or UEP; no pseudo labels/online learning/test adaptation.
architecture: StandardScaler3456 -> Linear64 -> GELU -> Dropout.25 -> Linear1 regression and Linear7 logits, shared bottleneck; backbone frozen cached.
target: Foldtrain mean/std, SmoothL1 beta1 on standardized hardness, mean CE coefficient.3. Six quantile boundaries j/7,j1..6 in original hardness, foldtrain only, searchsorted right. Duplicated cutpoints cause error, not silently changed bins.
paired_controls: Exactly identical initialized whole model, data permutations, dropout seed, optimizer/scheduler/epochs/regularization and both heads instantiated. Only auxiliary coefficient differs. Regression-only classifier gets no gradient and stays unchanged.
epoch_rule: 100 fixed epochs,last endpoint,cosine scheduler. Diagnostics epoch0/20/40/60/80/100 do not choose checkpoint. No loss/width/dropout/seed/epoch sweep.
primary: auxiliary_blend=.75samefold003+.25auxiliary. Matchedcontrol=.75samefold003+.25regression_only. Compare both to verified samefold006. Weights fixed, no Public adjustment.
screen: Advance auxiliary only if original pooled primary RMSE improves both006 and matchedcontrol, and >=3/5folds improve against each. Gate controls compute, not statistical significance. Otherwise stop, no wider search or fallback winner.
confirmation: If screen passes, identical recipe on both existing partitions20261031/20261101, refitting all heads/scalers/targetstats/bins within each fold. Only consistency across3partitions supports candidate consideration; no candidate created by this script.
resource: CPU2threads. Benchmark originalfold0 training only 10epochs eacharm, same100epoch scheduler; discard benchmark models. Stop if projected original10fits>5minutes or RSS>2GB.
scope: Development400 cached features/labels only. No image extraction, holdout/test reads, installs/cost/uploads. Historical repeated-selection bias remains.
